blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.
blocks.zh: 分布相匹配分解(DMD)通过将逆向KL相差最小化,将多步分解模型分解为几步分解出. 尽管表现很强,但DMD仅通过局部密度来引导样本,这引入了两个限制:教师分数在教师密度低的地区可能不可靠,而逆向KL的寻模式行为可以使学生倒向教师模式的一个子集. 我们首先将 DMD 与 Wasserstein 梯度流连接起来, 显示它的梯度来自一个固定点的配方, 以 整体 KL (IKL) 作为能量功能. 这种观点通过引导外部样本向目标走去并推广模式覆盖,用一个解决这些局限性的最佳运输术语来增强IKL。 我们用Sinkhorn从有限的批量中估计出来的分量来认识这个术语。 然而,在实践中,估计Sinkhorn速度的误差可以干扰IKL指导已经准确的域内样品。 为此,我们引入了SDMD,它根据歧义输出,适应性地激活了辛克霍恩校正,专注于IKL可能不可靠的外围样本. 在FLUX.1-dev、Quen-Image-20B和Wan2.1-14B上的2-4个取样步骤下,SDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE和V Bench上的分馏基线超过了业绩,同时在DMD2上改进了样品多样性。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) generate high-quality images and videos but require many sampling steps.
Diffusion distillation reduces this cost by transferring knowledge from a pretrained teacher to a student that generates samples in one or a few steps.
Existing approaches have advanced few-step generation by learning mappings along teacher trajectories ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2023 ) , using adversarial supervision ( Sauer et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , or directly matching student and teacher distributions ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
Among these, a representative approach is DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ) , which optimizes a reverse KL objective using the difference between teacher and student scores.
It has been widely adopted due to its high sample fidelity and scalability in large-scale image and video generation ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ; Ge et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
扩散模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年;Song等,2021年;Ho等,2020年)生成高质量的图像和视频,但需要许多取样步骤.
分泌分泌蒸馏法通过将知识从受过预训的老师传授给在一到几个步骤中生成样本的学生来降低这一成本.
现有方法通过沿教师轨迹进行学习测绘(Geng等,2025;Song等,2023),利用对抗监督(Sauer等,2024;Lin等,2025),或直接匹配学生和教师分布(徐等,2025;周等,2024.
其中具有代表性的方法有DMD(Yin等,2024b.),利用师生分数的分数来优化反向KL目标.
由于其在大规模图像和视频生成中具有高度的样本忠诚度和可扩展性而得到广泛采用(Fan等,2025;Zheng等,2026b; Ge等人,2025年 ).

blocks.en:
To better understand and improve the training dynamics of DMD, we view diffusion distillation from the perspective of Wasserstein gradient flow (WGF) ( Ambrosio et al., 2008 ) .
WGF evolves a probability distribution by steepest descent of an energy functional in Wasserstein space, with the corresponding velocity field specifying the update direction for each sample.
While recent works ( Han et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) use WGF to train one-step generators from scratch, we establish its connection to diffusion distillation by recovering the DMD gradient through fixed-point regression under the integral KL (IKL) energy, defined as reverse KL averaged over diffusion noise levels ( Sec. 4.1 ).
This identifies the energy underlying DMD and the velocity field that guides generated samples, allowing us to analyze the behavior and limitations of DMD and explore complementary energy functionals to improve distillation.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地理解和改进DMD的培训动态,我们从Wasserstein梯度流(WGF)的角度看待扩散分馏(Ambrosio等,2008年)。
WGF通过最陡峭地下降Wasserstein空间的能功能来演化出概率分布,相应的速度场为每个样本指定了更新方向.
虽然近期的作品(Han等,2026;He等,2026)使用WGF从零开始训练一步发电机,但我们通过在整体KL(IKL)能量下通过固定点回归来恢复DMD梯度来建立其与扩散分馏的联系,被定义为在扩散噪声水平上反向KL平均值(Sec 4.1)。
这明确了DMD的基础能量和引导生成样品的速度场,使我们能够分析DMD的行为和局限性,并探索辅助能功能来改进蒸馏.

blocks.en:
The IKL velocity of DMD reveals two practical limitations ( Fig. 2 ).
First, learned teacher scores can be unreliable for outlier samples, and the resulting updates may fail to guide them toward target modes.
Although adding diffusion noise can improve distributional overlap, outliers may remain poorly supported at low noise levels.
Higher noise levels can improve their support but blur the local structure of target modes.
Second, the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can concentrate the student on a subset of target modes, potentially reducing the diversity of generated samples.
blocks.zh:
DMD的IKL速度揭示出两个实际局限性(图2.
首先,学得的老师分数对于外出样本可能不可靠,由此产生的更新可能无法引导他们转向目标模式.
虽然增加扩散噪声可以改善分布重叠,但在低噪声水平下,输出者仍然得不到很好的支持.
更高的噪音水平可以改善它们的支持,但会模糊目标模式的局部结构.
第二,逆向KL的模式寻求行为可以将学生集中到一个子集的目标模式上,有可能降低生成样本的多样性.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we augment IKL with an optimal transport (OT) term.
OT couples student and target samples globally, providing robust guidance for outlier samples and promoting mode coverage without relying on learned teacher scores.
To exploit their complementary strengths, we propose combining global OT guidance with local IKL score updates that help capture fine details.
Our analysis shows that sufficiently strong exact OT regularization ensures convergence of the combined flow to the target under regularity assumptions ( Sec. 4.2 ).
For efficient computation, we use Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased form of entropic OT.
While Sinkhorn does not automatically inherit this guarantee, we establish sufficient conditions on its approximation error and regularization strength for the combined flow to converge to the target ( Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限性,我们以最佳运输(OT)术语增加了IKL。
OT夫妇的学生和目标样本在全球范围,为外部样本提供有力的指导,促进模式覆盖,而不依赖学到的教师分数。
为了发挥它们的互补优势,我们提议将全球OT指导与当地IKL分数更新结合起来,帮助获取细微细节.
我们的分析表明,足够有力的准确的OT规范化确保了在规范性假设下综合流动与目标一致(第4.2节)。
为了高效计算,我们使用辛克霍恩分数,一种去偏颇的热带OT形式.
虽然Sinkhorn不会自动继承这一保证,但我们为其近似误差和规范化强度设定了充分的条件,使综合流量能与目标汇合(第5节)。

blocks.en:
In practice, the transport maps used to compute Sinkhorn updates are estimated from finite samples, with larger batches generally reducing estimation error at greater computational cost ( Genevay et al., 2019 ) .
Notably, our experiments show that even with relatively few samples, Sinkhorn can provide more informative guidance than IKL for outlier samples where learned teacher scores are unreliable.
However, for well-supported samples, estimation errors in Sinkhorn can instead interfere with the accurate guidance already provided by IKL.
To this end, we introduce sDMD , which adaptively activates Sinkhorn guidance for samples with relatively weak teacher support based on discriminator outputs.
We reuse the discriminator trained for adversarial regularization in DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) , without training a separate model.
blocks.zh:
在实践中,用于计算Sinkhorn更新的运输地图是从有限度的样本中估算出来的,较大的批次一般会以更高的计算成本来减少估计出错(Genevay等,2019年).
值得注意的是,我们的实验表明,即使样本相对较少,辛克霍恩也可以提供比IKL更丰富的指导,用于那些学得师资分不可靠的超标.
然而,对于得到良好支持的样品,Sinkhorn的估算出错反而会干扰到IKL已经提供的准确指导.
为此,我们引入了SDMD,它适应性地激活了Sinkhorn对样本的指导,基于歧视者输出的教师支持相对薄弱.
我们重新使用在DMD2(Yin等,2024年a)中接受对抗正规化培训的歧视行为人,而无需单独培训。

blocks.en: We evaluate sDMD using 2–4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev ( Labs, 2024 ) and Qwen-Image-20B ( Wu et al., 2025 ) for text-to-image generation ( Fig. 1 ) and Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) (1.3B and 14B) for text-to-video generation. sDMD outperforms the distillation baselines in most metrics on GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) , DPG ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , and WISE ( Niu et al., 2025 ) , achieves the highest overall VBench scores on both Wan2.1 models, and improves all reported diversity metrics over the strong DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们使用FLUX.1-dev(Labs,2024年)和Quen-Image-20B(Wu等,2025年)上的2–4个采样步骤对SDMD进行文字到图像生成(图1)和Wan2.1(Wan等,2025年)(1.3B和14B)进行文字到视频生成的评价. SDMD在GenEval(Ghosh等人,2023年),DPG(Hu等人,2024年)和WISE(Niu等人,2025年)上,大多数度量衡的分数都超过了蒸馏基准,在Wan2.1模型上,V Bench的总体分数都最高,而且所有报告的多样性度量都超过了强大的DMD2(Yin等人,2024a年)基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
To reduce the sampling cost of multi-step diffusion models, trajectory-based distillation methods enable one or few-step generation by learning shortcuts along denoising trajectories ( Song et al., 2023 ; Boffi et al., 2025 ; Frans et al., 2025 ) .
Continuous-time formulations use JVPs ( Lu & Song, 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) , whose efficient computation at scale requires specialized implementations ( Zheng et al., 2026b ) .
Recent works aim to avoid JVP computation through specialized architectures that decouple sampling substeps from backbone evaluations ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Shaul et al., 2026 ) .
Adversarial approaches use discriminator-based supervision for distillation ( Sauer et al., 2023 ; Sauer et al., 2024 ) with potential training instability ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了降低多步骤扩散模型的取样成本,以轨迹为基础的蒸馏方法通过学习去诺氏轨迹的捷径,使一或几步生成成为可能(Song等,2023;Boffi等,2025;Frans等,2025)。
连续时间配方使用JVP(Lu & Song, 2025;Geng等, 2025),其规模高效计算需要专门实施(Zheng等, 2026b.).
近期的作品旨在通过专门架构来避免JVP的计算,这些架构将采样子步骤与骨干评价脱钩(Chen等,2026;Shaul等,2026.).
横向方法对蒸馏使用基于歧视的监督(Sauer等,2023;Sauer等,2024),潜在的培训不稳定(Lin等,2025)。

blocks.en:
Distribution-matching distillation methods align generated and target distributions through f f -divergence minimization ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) or score matching ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) .
Among these, DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Luo et al., 2023 ) minimizes the reverse KL divergence using the difference between teacher and student scores.
With their high sample fidelity and scalability, DMD-based methods have been widely adopted for high-resolution image synthesis and video generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) .
However, DMD remains sensitive to outliers and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) .
Our work augments DMD with a complementary velocity field to address these limitations and improve sample quality and diversity.
blocks.zh:
分布相配蒸馏方法通过f-潜水最小化(徐等,2025;谢等,2024)或分数相配(周等,2024;罗等,2024)使生成和靶向分布一致.
其中, DMD 磁盘 (Yin等,2024b;Luo等,2023) 利用师生分数之差来将反向KL分数最小化.
以高样本纯度和可伸缩性,DMD为基础的方法被广泛用于高分辨率图像合成和视频生成(Yin等,2025;Huang等,2025;Zheng等,2026b;Yin等,2024a).
然而,DMD仍然对异常点和逆向KL的模式寻求行为敏感(Bai等,2026;Luo等,2025)。
我们的工作为DMD提供了互补的速度领域,以克服这些局限性并改进样本质量和多样性。

blocks.en:
WGF ( Jordan et al., 1998 ; Ambrosio et al., 2008 ) evolves a probability distribution by steepest descent of an energy functional under the 2-Wasserstein metric.
When a divergence to the target distribution is chosen as the energy, the flow reduces the discrepancy between the two distributions, providing a framework for generative modeling.
For example, MMD flows ( Arbel et al., 2019 ) depend on kernel gradients and can provide weak guidance when generated and target samples are far apart relative to the kernel bandwidth.
This requires careful kernel design, such as noise-adaptive kernels ( Galashov et al., 2025 ) or kernels built from multiple feature encoders and scales ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
WGF(约旦等,1998年;Ambrosio等,2008年)在2-Wasserstein度量下,通过最陡峭地下降能量功能的概率分布。
当选择一个与目标分布的相差被作为能量时,流会减少两个分布之间的相差,为基因模型构建提供了框架.
例如,MMD流量(Arbel等,2019年)取决于内核梯度,在生成和目标样本相对于内核带宽而言相去甚远时,可以提供弱向导.
这需要精心设计内核,如噪声适应内核(Galashov等,2025年)或由多功能编码器和天平所建内核(Feng等,2026年;Deng等,2026年).

blocks.en:
Sinkhorn divergence provides transport-based guidance ( Genevay et al., 2018 ; Feydy et al., 2019 ) , and recent works ( Han et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) use its gradient flow to train one-step generators.
However, estimating transport from finite batches can introduce error into the resulting velocity field ( Pooladian & Niles-Weed, 2021 ; Genevay et al., 2019 ) .
Flows based on reverse KL between clean distributions use local score information to guide samples toward the target distribution ( Li et al., 2023 ; Liu, 2017 ; He et al., 2025 ) .
However, these approaches require known target densities or score estimates obtained through methods such as kernel density estimation, which can limit scalability in high-dimensional generation ( He et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, DMD offers a scalable diffusion distillation approach by applying reverse KL to noise-perturbed distributions with noise annealing.
In this work, we connect DMD to WGF and propose sDMD , which incorporates an optimal transport term to improve guidance for outlier samples and promote mode coverage.
blocks.zh:
Sinkhorn Difference提供以运输为主的指导(Genevay等,2018;Feydy等,2019;和近代作品(Han等,2026;He等,2026)用其梯度流来训练一步发电机.
然而,从有限批量估算运输量可能会给由此产生的速度场带来出错(Pouladian & Ners-Weed, 2021;Genevay等, 2019)。
基于倒向KL的流出在清洁分布之间,利用本地分数信息引导样本向目标分布方向前进(Li等,2023;Liu等,2017;He等,2025).
然而,这些方法需要通过内核密度估计等方法获得已知的目标密度或分数估计,这些方法可以限制高维代的可伸缩性(He等,2025;Han等,2026).
相形之下,DMD通过将反向KL应用到有噪声反射的噪声分泌上,提供了可伸缩扩散分馏方法.
在这项工作中,我们将DMD与WGF连接,并提议SDMD,其中包含一个最优的运输术语来改进对出地样品的取向并推广模式覆盖.

DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ) has shown strong empirical performance in few-step generation, but the original derivation of the gradient introduces diffusion noise without a formal connection to WGF.
We show that the DMD gradient in Eq. 1 follows from the WGF fixed-point relation in Eq. 3 .
Specifically, the DMD update can be viewed through the WGF framework by choosing the integral KL (IKL) divergence ( Luo et al., 2023 ) ,

blocks.en:
Diff-Instruct ( Luo et al., 2023 ) derives the generator score-difference update directly from IKL, but does not explicitly connect it to WGF.
ProlificDreamer ( Wang et al., 2023b ) derives a WGF update for text-to-3D particles, but does not consider distillation into few-step image or video generators.
Concurrent analyses ( Gretton et al., 2026 ; Turan et al., 2026 ) study WGF fixed-point regression for drifting models ( Deng et al., 2026 ) using kernel-smoothed KL rather than IKL, and also do not explicitly connect DMD to WGF.
In this work, we connect DMD to WGF under diffusion-noise-averaged KL from fixed-point regression and use this interpretation to introduce complementary Sinkhorn guidance for diffusion distillation.

同时期分析(Gretton等,2026;Turan等,2026)研究漂移模型的WGF定点回归(Deng等,2026)使用内核疏流的KL而不是IKL,也没有将DMD与WGF明确连接.

blocks.en: 4.2 Limitations of IKL
blocks.zh: 4.2 对IKL的限制

blocks.en:
DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ) and its follow-up methods Fan et al. (2026) ; Ge et al. (2025) have demonstrated empirical success in capturing fine details and scaling to high-resolution image generation ( Fan et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2024a ) and video generation ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
However, the gradient of IKL in DMD guides particles by local density alone, which brings two practical limitations.
First, the clean reverse KL gradient flow is ill-defined when p p and q q are mutually singular ( Glaser et al., 2021 ) .
Although forward diffusion gives p t p_{t} and q t q_{t} full support, in practice the learned teacher score may remain unreliable for generated samples with low teacher density, particularly at low noise levels.
Second, the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can cause the student to cover only a subset of the teacher modes.

然而,DMD中IKL的梯度仅通过局部密度来引导粒子,这带来了两个实际限制.

blocks.en:
We illustrate these limitations using an experiment with a 2D Gaussian mixture ( Fig. 2 ).
When the two distributions are well aligned, the predicted score is accurate and the particles converge onto the target ( Fig. 2 (a)).
However, when a generated sample lies in a low-density region of the teacher distribution, the predicted score becomes inaccurate, and the resulting velocity fails to carry the particles toward the target under weak diffusion annealing ( Fig. 2 (b)).
With higher noise levels, the sample can be better supported, but the velocity can ignore the local structure of the target distribution, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the particles onto a single mode ( Fig. 2 (c)).
blocks.zh:
我们用二维高斯混合物(图2)的实验来说明这些局限性。
当两种分布对齐时,预测得分准确,粒子会汇合到目标上(图2(a))。
然而,当生成的样本位于师资分布的低密度区域时,预测得分会变得不准确,由此产生的速度无法将颗粒带入微弱的散射反射下的目标(图2(b))。
随着噪音水平的提高,样本可以得到更好的支持,但速度可以忽略目标分布的局部结构,而逆向KL的寻求模式行为可以将粒子倒向单一模式(图2(c)).

blocks.en:
These limitations motivate augmenting IKL with an optimal transport (OT) regularizer.
We show that IKL alone does not guarantee convergence from arbitrary initializations, whereas the WGF of exact OT contracts toward the target.
Under regularity assumptions, a sufficiently strong exact OT term counteracts the negative curvature of IKL and ensures convergence of the combined flow to the target in Wasserstein distance ( Theorem 1 ).
We provide a failure case for IKL and a sufficient condition on the OT regularization strength for convergence in Sec. B.2 .
In the next section, we introduce a practical transport correction that complements IKL.
blocks.zh:
这些限制促使IKL增加最佳的运输调节器。
我们显示,仅靠IKL并不能保证任意初始化的趋同,而确切OT合同的WGF则能够保证目标趋同。
在规律性假设下,足够强的准确的OT名词会抵消IKL的负曲率,并确保了与瓦瑟斯坦距离(定理1 )中目标的综合流量的趋同.
我们为IKL提供了一个失败案例,并为在Sec.B.2中趋同提供了OT正规化强度的充分条件。
在下一节中,我们引入了对IKL进行补充的实际运输修正。

blocks.en: 5.1 Complementing IKL with Sinkhorn Divergence
blocks.zh: 5.1 以辛克霍恩差异补充IKL

blocks.en:
Despite the favorable convergence properties of exact OT, it can be computationally prohibitive.
Instead, we use Sinkhorn divergence, a computationally tractable, debiased form of entropic OT with more favorable sample complexity ( Cuturi, 2013 ; Genevay et al., 2019 ) .
We compare this choice with other energy functionals, including forward KL and MMD, in Sec. 6.3 .
blocks.zh:
尽管准确的OT具有有利的趋同性,但从计算上讲,它可能令人望而却步。
相反,我们使用的是Sinkhorn Difference,一种可计算取向的、具有更优惠样本复杂性的热带OT的去偏见形式(Cuturi,2013;Genevay等,2019)。
我们把这一选择与其他能源功能进行比较,包括远期KL和MMD,载于第6.3节。

blocks.en:
IKL and Sinkhorn induce complementary velocity fields that are useful in different regimes.
IKL captures fine details through local score guidance in regions well supported by the teacher, whereas Sinkhorn uses a global transport plan to guide particles with weak teacher support toward the target and promote mode coverage ( Fig. 2 (d)).

IKL通过教师支持的地区的地方分数指导获取了细微细节,而Sinkhorn则使用全球运输计划来引导教师支持薄弱的粒子向目标走去并推广模式覆盖(图2(d))。

In Sec. B.3 , we show that the velocity field is identifiable, i.e., V sDMD-U ≡ 0 V_{\text{sDMD-U}}\equiv 0 if and only if q = p q=p .
The score difference is obtained by passing the perturbed student samples x t x_{t} through the teacher and student score networks.
Additionally, the transport term is computed using batches of student and teacher samples, i.e., { x ( i ) } i = 1 M q ∼ q \{x^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{M_{q}}\sim q and { y ( i ) } i = 1 M p ∼ p \{y^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{M_{p}}\sim p , on which the Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm returns the two projections of Eq. 6 .

In practice, however, the transport plan is computed on finite batches of student and teacher samples, which introduces error in the resulting velocity ( Genevay et al., 2019 ; Pooladian & Niles-Weed, 2021 ) .
As a result, applying Sinkhorn at every iteration can perturb well-supported samples for which IKL already provides reliable guidance, as highlighted by the red boxes in Fig. 2 (d), while adding computational cost.
We therefore seek a criterion that adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction for samples with relatively weak teacher support, for which IKL guidance may be unreliable.
blocks.zh:
然而,实际上,运输计划是根据有限的一批学生和教师样本计算的,这引入了由此产生的速度错误(日内瓦等,2019年;Pouladian & Ners-Weed,2021年)。
因此,每个迭代都应用Sinkhorn可以扰动支持良好的样本,而IKL已经提供了可靠的指导,图2(d)中的红框强调了这一点,同时增加了计算成本.
因此,我们寻求一种标准,即适应性地启动Sinkhorn校正样本,其师资支持相对薄弱,而IKL的指导可能不可靠。

blocks.zh: 5.3 实际考虑

blocks.en:
The transport in Eq. 6 is computed on the sampled latents x ∈ ℝ d x\in\mathbb{R}^{d} of the student and the teacher.
Instead, it can be computed in a feature space given a network ψ : ℝ d → ℝ n \psi:\mathbb{R}^{d}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n} , replacing the samples with the feature vectors ψ ⁡ ( x ) ∈ ℝ n \psi(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{n} .
We empirically find that Sinkhorn transport computed in the clean latent space already provides effective guidance for outlier samples, avoiding the additional cost of a feature encoder.
With this choice, sDMD incurs only marginal computational overhead compared with DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) .
We present an ablation of the transport space and an analysis of computational cost in Sec. 6.3 and Appendix E , respectively.

blocks.en:
For conditional generation, we compute Sinkhorn transport between M q M_{q} student samples and M p M_{p} teacher samples generated under the same conditioning input.
To reduce training cost, we pre-generate the teacher samples for each conditioning input and store them in a buffer.
While previous works applied Sinkhorn divergence to class-conditioned generation ( Han et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) , we extend its use to text-conditioned generation.

虽然之前的作品将Sinkhorn差异应用到有类条件的生成(Han等,2026;He等,2026),但我们将其使用范围扩大到有文本条件的生成.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we proposed sDMD , a diffusion distillation method that combines local score guidance of DMD with global transport.
We first connected DMD to WGF by showing that the fixed-point relation with IKL as the energy functional recovers the DMD gradient.
This connection enabled us to explore energy functionals that address unreliable guidance for outliers and limited mode coverage in DMD.
Specifically, we augmented IKL with Sinkhorn divergence and introduced an adaptive scheduler to focus transport guidance on samples with relatively weak teacher support.
Experiments showed that sDMD improves sample quality and diversity over strong diffusion distillation baselines in image and video generation with only marginal training overhead than DMD2.
We discuss limitations and future work in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了SDMD,一种将DMD的局部分分指导与全球运输相结合的传播分馏法.
我们首先将DMD与WGF连接,显示与作为能函数的IKL的固定点关系恢复了DMD梯度.
这种连接使我们能够探索能源功能,解决对外部用户的不可靠的指导以及DMD中有限的模式覆盖.
具体地说,我们用Sinkhorn的分数增加了IKL,并采用了一个适应性调度器,以在教师支助相对薄弱的样本上提供运输指导。
实验显示,SDMD在图像和视频生成方面,比起强大的扩散分馏基线,其样本质量和多样性得到了提高,其培训费用仅比DMD2低。

blocks.en:
DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ) uses diffusion-perturbed scores to approximate the clean reverse KL gradient, without an explicit connection to WGF.
Diff-Instruct ( Luo et al., 2023 ) derives the IKL gradient for generator training without connecting it to WGF.
ProlificDreamer ( Wang et al., 2023b ) derives a WGF update for 3D particles through a renderer, without considering fixed-point regression.
While concurrent works ( Gretton et al., 2026 ; Turan et al., 2026 ) analyze kernel-smoothed KL and fixed-point training for drifting models, they do not explicitly study IKL averaged over diffusion noise levels or its connection to DMD.
We focus on diffusion distillation with pretrained teacher scores, recovering the widely used DMD update through fixed-point regression under the IKL energy.
This WGF perspective provides a common framework for deriving and combining velocity fields from complementary energy functionals to address the limitations of DMD in few-step image and video generation.

Sec. 4.2 discusses two limitations of DMD: unreliable guidance for outlier samples and mode collapse.

These properties make Sinkhorn alone a natural candidate for distillation.
Indeed, concurrent works demonstrate that Sinkhorn can train generators from scratch ( Han et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) .
However, our analysis assumes that p p and q q are known exactly, while training computes Sinkhorn from finite batches.
Finite batches introduce estimation errors in the entropic transport cost and the barycentric maps used to compute the velocity ( Genevay et al., 2019 ; Pooladian & Niles-Weed, 2021 ) .

这些特性使辛克霍恩独自成为了蒸馏的自然候选.

有限批次引入了演化运输成本的估计误差和用于计算速度的巴以中心地图(Genevay等,2019;Pouladian & Ners-Weed,2021)。

blocks.en:
Therefore, small transport batches can yield inaccurate Sinkhorn guidance.
In our ablation, Sinkhorn alone underperforms IKL ( Tab. 3 ).
Nevertheless, combining Sinkhorn with IKL improves generation quality even with relatively small transport batches ( Tab. 9 ).
We interpret this improvement in terms of their complementary roles: despite its own estimation error, Sinkhorn can provide more informative guidance than IKL for outlier samples, while IKL captures fine details in regions well supported by the teacher ( Fig. 2(d) ).
blocks.zh:
因此,小批量运输可产生不准确的Sinkhorn制导.
在我们的恩典中,辛克霍恩独自表现不佳IKL(Tab. 3).
尽管如此,将Sinkhorn和IKL结合起来,即使运输批量相对较小,也能提高发电质量(附件9)。
我们从互补作用的角度来解释这种改进:尽管Sinkhorn本身有估计错误,但对于外部样本,它比IKL可以提供更翔实的指导,而IKL则在教师支持的地区捕捉到精细的细节(图2(d))。

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Related Works
blocks.zh: 附录C 相关作品

blocks.en:
Recent methods train one- or few-step generators directly from data ( Song et al., 2023 ; Frans et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Boffi et al., 2025 ) , with often using JVPs during training ( Lu & Song, 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) .
Further advances improve stability and sample quality through revised objectives and training strategies ( Song & Dhariwal, 2024 ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and reduce computation costs through finite-difference approximations ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
On the other hand, recent methods use mini-batch particle interactions to align generated and target distributions during training ( Han et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) .
Our work distills few-step image and video generators from pretrained multi-step diffusion models widely used in real-world applications ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Labs, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
最近的方法直接从数据中训练出一步或几步的发电机(Song等,2023;Frans等,2025;Zhou等,2025;Boffi等,2025;),在训练期间经常使用JVP(Lu & Song等,2025;Geng等,2025.).
进一步的进展通过修订目标和培训战略(Song & Dhariwal, 2024;Geng等, 2026;Lu等, 2026;Zhang等, 2026)提高了稳定性和样本质量,并通过有限偏差近似值降低了计算成本(Wang等, 2026)。
另一方面,最近的方法利用小批量粒子相互作用,使训练期间生成的和靶向的分布一致(Han等,2026;Deng等,2026.).
我们的工作从在现实世界应用中广泛使用的经过预先训练的多步骤传播模型中提取出几步图像和视频生成器(Wu等,2025;Wan等,2025;Labs,2024)。

blocks.en:
WGF evolves probability distributions by steepest descent of an energy functional under the 2-Wasserstein metric ( Ambrosio et al., 2008 ) .
The Jordan–Kinderlehrer–Otto (JKO) scheme ( Jordan et al., 1998 ) approximates this flow by minimizing the energy functional at each step, with a squared 2-Wasserstein penalty that keeps the updated distribution close to the distribution from the preceding step.
Neural implementations ( Mokrov et al., 2021 ; Fan et al., 2021 ) optimize a transport map at each JKO step which incur quadratic training cost in the number of JKO steps.
More efficient formulations have been proposed ( Choi et al., 2024 ; Bonet et al., 2021 ) , but their evaluation does not extend to the scale and dimensionality of modern generative models.
In this work, we apply the WGF framework to diffusion distillation, training few-step image and video generators from large pretrained diffusion teachers.
blocks.zh:
WGF通过在2-Wasserstein度量下最陡峭地下降能量功能而演变出概率分布(Ambrosio等人,2008年)。
约旦-Kinderlehrers-Otto(JKO)计划(Jordan等,1998年)通过尽量减少每一步骤的能动性来估计这一流量,并处以平方的2-Wasserstein惩罚,使更新的分布与前一步骤的分布接近。
神经实施 (Mokrov等,2021;Fan等,2021)优化了JKO每个步骤的运输地图,在JKO步骤的数量上产生四重训练费用.
提出了更高效的配体(Choi等,2024;Bonet等,2021),但其评价没有延伸到现代基因模型的规模和维度.
在这项工作中,我们运用WGF框架来传播蒸馏,从经过预先培训的大型传播教师那里培训几步相机和相机.

blocks.en:
The high sample quality and scalability of DMD have led to broad adoption in high-resolution image synthesis ( Yin et al., 2024a ) , hybrid consistency training for image and video generation ( Zheng et al., 2026b ) , and autoregressive video generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Recent advances further improve its training and sampling: SenseFlow ( Ge et al., 2025 ) introduces fake-score alignment, while Decoupled DMD ( Liu et al., 2026 ) uses separate noise schedules for CFG augmentation and distribution matching.
Other methods improve few-step distillation by matching intermediate distributions along the denoising trajectory ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) .
Additionally, recent works combine DMD-based and trajectory-based training objectives for few-step generation ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Nie et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
DMD的高采样质量和可扩展性在高分辨率图像合成(Yin等,2024a),图像和视频生成的混合一致性培训(郑等等,2026b)和自递视频生成(Yin等,2025;黄等,2025;杨等,2025)中被广泛采用.
最近的进展进一步加强了培训和取样: SenseFlow(Ge等,2025年)引入了假分对等,而Decoupled DMD(Liu等,2026年)则对CFG扩能和配分配对使用单独的噪声表.
其他方法通过匹配去诺氏轨迹的中间分布,改进了几步分馏(Luo等,2025;Fan等,2026)。
此外,近期的作品将基于DMD和基于轨迹的培训目标结合到少步一代(Cheng等人,2026;Nie等人,2026b;Gu等人,2026).

blocks.en:
Meanwhile, AMD ( Bai et al., 2026 ) shares our concern about unreliable teacher guidance, but uses reward scores as a diagnostic proxy to adapt distillation updates.
We derive the DMD update from WGF under the IKL energy, opening a design space of energy functionals for improving distillation. sDMD builds on this formulation by adding complementary Sinkhorn transport to improve sample quality and diversity.
Additionally, this transport correction may complement the above DMD training strategies which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh:
同时,AMD (Bai等,2026年)共同关注不可靠的教师指导,但使用奖励分数作为诊断代用来适应蒸馏更新.
我们在IKL能量下从WGF获得DMD更新,打开了能源功能的设计空间来改进蒸馏. SDMD基于这种配方,增加了互补的Sinkhorn运输,以提高样品质量和多样性.
此外,这种运输修正可以补充我们留给今后工作的上述DMD培训战略。

blocks.en:
As discussed in Sec. 5.1 , while Sinkhorn transport provides global guidance toward the teacher distribution, in practice it is computed using a finite number of samples per condition, which may introduce errors into the transport velocity.
To analyze the effect of this finite-sample approximation, we show ablation results on ImageNet-256 ( Deng et al., 2009 ) in Tab. 9(a) and Tab. 9(b) , which sweep the student sample count M q M_{q} with M p = 8 M_{p}=8 and the teacher sample count M p M_{p} with M q = 8 M_{q}=8 , respectively.
In both cases, using too few samples degrades generation quality, with a more pronounced degradation when fewer teacher samples ( M p M_{p} ) are used.
However, sDMD recovers robust performances even with relatively low number of samples from each distribution ( M q ≥ 8 , M p ≥ 8 M_{q}\geq 8,M_{p}\geq 8 ).
These results suggest that Sinkhorn velocities estimated from relatively few samples can still provide more informative guidance than IKL velocities for out-of-distribution samples, thereby improving generation quality.

为了分析这种有限-样本近似效应,我们显示在ImageNet-256(Deng等人,2009年) Tab.9(a)和Tab.9(b)上的读取结果,它们分别将学生样本数M q M_{q}用M p = 8 M_{p}=8 和教师样本数M q = 8 M_{q}=8 。

这些结果表明,从相对较少的样本中估计的辛克霍恩速度仍然能够提供比分配外样本的IKL速度更丰富的指导,从而提高了生成质量.

Tab. 10 compares the training and sampling costs of sDMD with DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) and training a one-step generator from scratch ( Han et al., 2026 ) .
All experiments in our cost analysis are conducted on NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
For sDMD , we consider two choices of computing the self-transport map T q , q T_{q,q} in Eq. 6 : diagonal masking ( Deng et al., 2026 ) and two-batch ( Han et al., 2026 ) .
Diagonal masking reuses a single student batch while preventing each sample from matching itself, whereas two-batch estimation computes transport between two independent student batches.
With diagonal masking, sDMD improves generation quality over DMD2 while increasing training cost by only around 3.5%.
Using two batches further improves FID at additional training cost, consistent with the observations of Han et al. (2026) .

Recent methods achieve high generation quality by training one-step generators from scratch ( Han et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) .
In our analysis, we observe that teacher pretraining followed by distillation still requires fewer GPU hours than training a model from scratch ( Han et al., 2026 ) ( Tab. 10 ).
Additionally, advances in representation learning further accelerate convergence and improve generation quality of pretrained models ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) , supporting for pretraining followed by distillation as an efficient practice.

在分析中,我们看到,教师的预训和蒸馏仍需要更少的GPU时间,而不是从零开始培训一个模型(Han等人,2026年)(Tab. 10)。
此外,代表性学习的进展还进一步加快了预先培训的模型的趋同,并提高了生成质量(Yu等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2026年a),支持预先培训,然后将蒸馏作为一种有效的做法。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en:
For conditional generation, sDMD requires multiple teacher samples for each conditioning input to estimate Sinkhorn guidance.
While our ablations show that relatively few samples suffice to provide effective guidance for outlier samples, generating these samples still adds computational costs.
Additionally, although our gated Sinkhorn scheduler improves performance, it uses discriminator outputs as a proxy for identifying samples with relatively weak teacher support.
Exploring more reliable criteria for identifying samples that benefit from Sinkhorn guidance remains an interesting direction for future work.
Lastly, we compute transport in the clean latent space for video diffusion models to reduce computational overhead.
Exploring video feature spaces that provide a favorable balance between sample quality and computational cost remains future work.
blocks.zh:
对于有条件的生成,SDMD要求每个调制输入需要多个教师样本来估计Sinkhorn指导.
虽然我们的模拟显示,相对较少的样本足以为外部样本提供有效的指导,但生成这些样本仍会增加计算成本。
此外,尽管我们的门牌Sinkhorn排程器提高了性能,但它使用歧视性产出作为识别教师支持相对薄弱的样本的代名词。
探索更可靠的标准,以确定受益于Sinkhorn指导的样本,仍然是今后工作的一个令人感兴趣的方向。
最后,我们计算在清洁的潜在空间中的运输量,用于视频传播模型,以减少计算间接费用。
探索在样本质量和计算成本之间取得有利平衡的视频功能空间仍然是今后的工作。
